definition: Astroinformatics is an interdisciplinary field of study involving the combination of astronomy, data science, machine learning, informatics, and information/communications technologies.
details: The field is closely related to astrostatistics. Data-driven astronomy (DDA) refers to the use of data science and machine learning techniques to analyze large astronomical datasets produced by telescopes and other observation platforms.
story: Think of a referee whose job is to be completely honest about who touched the ball last. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. What gets measured is what actually gets better. And that, done honestly, is Astroinformatics.
